rules.name: pii_public
rules.reason: customer posted personal details publicly ({match}); ask them to delete the tweet and move to DM

rules.name: safety
rules.pattern: \b(kill myself|suicid\w*|self[- ]harm|end my life|want to die|hurt (myself|someone)|shoot (you|them|up)|bomb|passed away|deceased|died|late (husband|wife|mother|father|mom|dad|son|daughter|brother|sister))\b

rules.name: legal_press
rules.reason: legal/press/law-enforcement signal ({match}); support does not answer these publicly

rules.name: data_privacy_deletion
rules.reason: data-privacy or account-deletion request ({match}); requires identity verification and a human process

rules.name: breach_phishing
rules.reason: possible security incident or phishing check ({match}); never speculate publicly

rules.name: money_moved
rules.reason: money or paid-plan state is involved ({match}); requires a payment-history lookup and refunds are never promised publicly

rules.name: chase_or_channel
rules.pattern: \b(no ?one (is |has )?(respond\w*|answer\w*|repl\w*|help\w*)|still waiting|been waiting|(sent|send|wrote) (you |u )?(a |an |several |\d+ )?(dm|dms|email|emails|message|messages)|check (your|ur|the) dms?|answer (my|the|ur|your) dms?|(phone|telephone) (number|support|line)|call (you|someone|spotify)|(speak|talk) (to|with) (a |an |someone|somebody|human|person|real)|contact me|get (back|in touch) (to|with) me)\b
rules.reason: customer is chasing support or asking for a channel ({match}); a human must be in the DM thread

rules.name: hacked_beyond_self_serve
rules.reason: account compromise beyond the self-serve page ({match}); needs backstage recovery in DM

rules.name: steps_tried_or_account_scoped
rules.pattern: \b(re-?install\w*|uninstall\w*|logg?(ed|ing) out and|log(ged)? out.{0,30}(back )?in|restart(ed|ing)? (my |the )?(phone|device|computer|laptop|pc|mac)|tried everything|every device|all (my |of my )?devices|any device|playlists? (are |is |have |has |got )?(all )?(gone|disappeared|deleted|vanished|missing|wiped)|(library|liked songs|saved songs|saved music) (is |are |has |have )?(all )?(gone|disappeared|deleted|missing)|(second|third|\d+(st|nd|rd|th)) time|new phone|keeps? (happening|deleting|removing|disappearing)|always (deletes|removes|disappears))\b
rules.reason: account-scoped symptom or self-serve steps already tried ({match}); troubleshooting ladder exhausted

rules.name: intent_escalate
rules.reason: intent '{match}' requires an account lookup or human follow-up

rules.name: intent_auto
rules.reason: intent '{match}' is self-serve on first contact: public canned reply / troubleshooting rung 1 / help page
